LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Mammoth.label: tiny mammoth
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Mammoth.description: An unmanned tracked armed carrier used for armed transport, hauling ammunition and supplies to the front line. It has some self-defense capability and high endurance, so the colonial fleets on the rim often use it for caravan transport.
